ItemDescription.Value: MutliLittleFixes（许多小修小补）- A collection of QoL fixes and tweaks for Bannerlord. - 无弹药远程自动移交第 9 队：Out-of-ammo ranged units are auto-moved to formation 9, and rejoin when ammo is restored. - 经验/属性红利/技能上限倍率：XP multiplier (up to x1000), per-attribute learning rate, and per-skill level caps (10-1024). - 王国 AI 修复：Disable AI declarations of war, player must be a candidate when taking a city, forbid AI recruiting/donating player clan troops. - NPC 领主部队增强：Extra party limit for NPC clans, released-lord reinforcement, compensation party limit when losing fiefs (with Kingdom bonus tab). - 战斗与阵型：Auto-crouch shield wall, banner-bearer repositioning, couch lance always knockdowns, battle result sort order reversal. - 攻城与海战：Siege engines prioritize enemy engines, trajectory preview for ballista/mangonel, coordinate targeting for AI engines, adjustable naval ship cap (War Sails DLC optional). - 粮草与补给：Food convoy between player fiefs (auto logistics), recruit/volunteer upgrade rate multipliers, custom deployment ratio. - 杂项：Date-time save naming, clan member available toast, prisoner special NPC tags, exile family filter & never-die. Requires: Harmony, ButterLib, UIExtenderEx, MBOptionScreen. Tested on v1.4.5 / v1.4.6. Source: github.com/huan-zz3/MutliLittleFixes
